title: Private Wildlife and Scenic tour on Antelope Island
includes: In-person guide is also the driver
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Let's go on a safari together, and let's do it at your pace! No crowded buses or vans, with people you don't know! Instead, explore the island in a comfortable private vehicle with a guide that will cater to you!

Join us as we search for one of the largest publicly owned bison herds in North America, and search for pronghorn antelope and mule deer along the way.

Learn about the early Paleo people who hunted on the shores of the island 12,000 years ago, as well as the sheep and cattle herders that called this unforgiving land home into the 1980's. 

Antelope island is not just about the history and animals, but also about the beautiful scenery surrounding it. As we climb Buffalo point, see the amazing panoramic view of the Wasatch Mountains and Great Salt Lake; and for those wanting a more scenic experience, unforgettable sunset tours are also available.
